author: The Infographics Show
description:
You might be stuck playing The Sims 4 forever. The Sims 5 you imagined is dead, and today we're going to break down the reason. In an era where the traditional gaming sequel cycle is being abandoned, EA has realized that shutting down their most successful "money machine" is a risk they aren't willing to take.

0:00 - The Mystery of Project Rene
0:43 - History of a Money Machine
2:06 - The Weaponized DLC Model
3:14 - Expansion vs. New Games
4:09 - The $1,500 Hobby
5:06 - Why EA Won't Reset
6:12 - The Psychological Trap of DLC
7:49 - The End of the Monopoly
8:24 - Next-Gen Rivals
9:47 - The Multiplayer Pivot
11:00 - AI & the Future of Sims
12:04 - The Risk of Starting Over
13:09 - The "Forever Game" Strategy

Narrated by: Josh Risser
